en: The lower lip is sweet, the face is sweet, the eye is sweet, and the smile is sweet;
the heart is sweet, the gait is sweet, and everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is entirely sweet.
(1) The garment is sweet, the conduct is sweet, the speech is sweet, and the turn of the body is sweet.
The movement is sweet, the whirling is sweet; everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is sweet.
(2) The flute is sweet, the pollen is sweet, the hand is sweet, and the feet are sweet.
The dance is sweet, the friendship is sweet; everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is sweet. (3)
The song is sweet, the drink is sweet, the food is sweet, and sleep is sweet;
the form is sweet, the forehead mark is sweet—everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is sweet.
The instrument is sweet, the crossing over is sweet, the taking away is sweet, and the delight is sweet.
The vomited [nectar] is sweet, the pacified is sweet; everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is sweet.
(5) The *guñjā* berry is sweet, the garland is sweet, the Yamunā is sweet, the wave is sweet;
the water is sweet, the lotus is sweet; everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is sweet. (6)
The gopīs are sweet, their pastimes are sweet, Rādhā is sweet, and their meeting is sweet;
what is seen is sweet, what remains is sweet—everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is sweet.
(7) The cowherds are sweet, the cows are sweet, the sacrificial post is sweet, and the creation is sweet.
The crushed is sweet, the ripened is sweet; everything belonging to the Lord of Sweetness is sweet.
Thus ends the *Madhurāṣṭaka* composed by the venerable Vallabhācārya. May this be offered unto Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
